query:
-- Easter (April), Mother's Day (May), Back to School (August), Christmas (December)
-- Using subgroup='Total' and campus='All Campuses' for the true total
SELECT year, month, subgroup, campus, avgWeekly, total
FROM attendance_monthly 
WHERE month IN (4, 5, 8, 12) 
  AND subgroup = 'Total'
  AND campus = 'All Campuses'
ORDER BY year DESC, month
